description:
Salad turns downtime into downloads. Run Salad whenever you're away from the keys to score games, gift cards, subscriptions, DLC, and more at the Salad Storefront.


Update to version 1.9.23:
- Fixes false "Elevated RAM allocation was disabled" notifications on correctly configured machines.
- Fixes the Chopping Power "allow Salad to use the optimal amount of RAM" step showing as incomplete on machines where elevated RAM was fully applied.
- Adds a recovery for container workloads that could get stuck in "Stopping" and never fully stop.
- Fixes cached container images being incorrectly left marked as in use, and container events being attributed to the wrong workload.
- Fixes the temporary GPU pause for heavy processes failing to lift automatically, which could leave a machine unable to run GPU workloads (despite a "GPU Workloads Restored" notification) until GPU sharing was manually re-enabled.
- Fixes the Contact Support links opening the knowledge base home page instead of the contact form.
- Adds a crypto mining opt-in switch to the Common Settings step of machine onboarding (enabled by default).
- General maintenance and reliability improvements.
Windows 10 and 11: Salad-1.9.23.exe
